name: Williden Marshal
summary: At Marshal's Refuge, Williden Marshal keeps his expedition alive after beasts drove it from Un'Goro Crater's lower camps. He still hopes the crater's plants, crystals and scientific research will bring discovery and profit.

sections.title: A Precarious Foothold
sections.body: Williden Marshal brought a scientific expedition into Un'Goro Crater to seek discovery and fortune. Strange crystals, unrecorded plants and other resources drew him to the valley floor, where he set up several camps. The crater's beasts soon tore through the research posts. Williden and the survivors fled to the northern cliffs and made their base at Marshal's Refuge.

sections.title: Salvaging the Dream
sections.body: Williden refuses to abandon the expedition after losing its lower camps. From Marshal's Refuge, he asks travelers to search the lowlands for lost food crates, scientific instruments and his expedition journal. Close companions such as Spark Nilminer call him Wil, but Williden takes the work seriously. The expedition's research remains in the valley, beneath the paths of its great predators.

sections.title: Family Ties
sections.body: Hol'anyee Marshal works alongside Williden at Marshal's Refuge. The two Marshals chose the wild crater in southern Kalimdor for their expedition. Williden still believes Un'Goro's crystal deposits and ancient mysteries can bring them fortune.

faq.answer: Williden Marshal leads Marshal's Expedition, a team of human researchers and adventurers in Un'Goro Crater. He brought them there to study its strange crystals and plants, hoping to gain knowledge and profit.

faq.q: Why is the expedition holed up in a cave?
aliases: why is the refuge in a cave
what happened to the expedition camps
faq.answer: The crater's great predators drove the expedition from its lower research camps in Un'Goro's lowlands. The survivors fled to the northern cliffs and now shelter at Marshal's Refuge.

faq.q: What is Williden asking adventurers to do?
faq.answer: Williden asks travelers to search the dangerous crater basin for supplies lost at the ruined camps. These include food, scientific instruments and his expedition journal.

faq.q: What brought Williden to Un'Goro Crater in the first place?
faq.answer: Williden came to Un'Goro Crater for its rare plants, mysterious crystals and ancient geological secrets. He hopes scientific discoveries will bring profit back home.
Yes. Hol'anyee Marshal is Williden's sister and works alongside him at Marshal's Refuge as part of the Marshal Expeditions.

faq.q: Is Williden Marshal aligned with the Alliance or Horde?
faq.answer: Williden leads a neutral scientific expedition from Marshal's Refuge. He accepts help from Alliance and Horde travelers willing to recover supplies and clear dangers from the crater.

angles.text: As a human, Williden reflects humanity's curiosity and ambition. He traveled from the Eastern Kingdoms to the wilds of southern Kalimdor.
As an Alliance member, you can see Williden's team working neutrally in the wild crater while keeping cultural and trade ties to the Alliance heartlands.
As a herbalist, you may understand why Un'Goro's unusual prehistoric plants drew Williden's expedition to the crater.
